# Yare

Yare is durable work memory for AI agents.

It gives agents and humans a clean handoff: what changed, what is true, what is unresolved, what needs human review, proof receipts, and the next clean action.

## Primary links

- Site: https://yare-vert.vercel.app/
- Use cases: https://yare-vert.vercel.app/use-cases.html
- Proof bench: https://yare-vert.vercel.app/proof
- GitHub: https://github.com/electricwolfemarshmallowhypertext/Yare
- License: https://github.com/electricwolfemarshmallowhypertext/Yare/blob/main/LICENSE

## Use cases

- AI coding teams
- Engineering audit
- Contradiction and approval review
- Restart after a partial run
- Cross-tool memory read
- State change review
- Search prior memory
- Archive proof artifacts
- Local handoff export
- Sandbox access evidence
